'''Yu''' is an NPC in [[Huanglong]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yu:''' Grandma's always trying to have me to sign up for the Rangers. Telling me how I should look up to my older sister more.
:'''Yu:''' But I want to stay home. Where I can be there for her if something happens.
:{{DIcon}} Mrs. Jué really has it thought out.
::'''Yu:''' I know. Grandma always talks about how, "only when a nation is at peace, can families be at peace". But I can't just leave her by herself.
:{{DIcon}} Good point.
:'''Yu:''' That's right. I've been learning boxing from Mister [[Yuanwu]] lately. I've got enough skills to protect Grandma against anything!
{{Dialogue End}}
